source_caption_text:
EST Gee was in his bag during this era 😤🔥

EST Gee really had the pandemic era in a chokehold. While everyone was stuck at home, his music was everywhere, and “Lick Back” became one of those tracks that instantly took over. The Louisville rapper brought a raw energy that felt completely different from what was dominating the scene at the time, turning every release into something fans had to pay attention to.

Pandemic-era EST Gee was genuinely a 99 overall. His delivery was cold, his flows were effortless, and every verse sounded like he had something to prove. “Lick Back” especially showed why he was quickly becoming one of the most talked-about new voices, with its hard production and nonstop bars making it impossible to ignore.

Looking back, that run feels like the moment EST Gee officially arrived. He went from being a rising name to earning major co-signs and eventually bringing Future and Young Thug onto the remix. For fans who were locked in during that era, pandemic EST Gee was a different kind of problem.

#estgee #hiphop #rap
